name: Absent Fathers
overview: Scripture reveals the deep care and provision of God for those who experience the absence or loss of earthly fathers, affirming that even when parents forsake their children, the LORD gathers and sustains them (Psalms 27:10). God is described as the Father of the fatherless and a protector who preserves and relieves the vulnerable (Psalms 68:5; 146:9). Additionally, the Bible emphasizes the responsibility of fathers to leave a godly inheritance and to train their children in the way of the Lord, which provides lasting guidance and stability (Proverbs 13:22; 22:6). The imagery of one who wanders from their place highlights the importance of a father’s role in providing a secure and nurturing environment (Proverbs 27:8).
